Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick reply and the clear budget signal — that's super helpful. Below is a concise table and some options so you can pick what fits best.

Pricing (illustrative, per 1M tokens) — baseline (committed) vs overage vs expedited add-on:
- Baseline committed (monthly) — $850 / 1M tokens (for a 200M token commit)
- Overage (paid as used beyond commit) — $1,350 / 1M tokens
- Expedited quota increase (one-time, same month) — +25% on baseline unit price for the increase; guaranteed within 24 hours if approved
- Dedicated burst SLA (if you need guaranteed bursts without throttle) — custom pricing; typically ~ +40–60% on blended unit economics but provides reserved GPU pools and guaranteed burst windows

Notes: 
- We support a "soft cap" workflow: by default we notify at 80/90/100% of commit and will auto-enroll an expedited increase if you opt in (you only pay the expedited rate for the extra tokens). Without opt-in, you remain on overage pricing and we will not silently increase your quota.
- For the 2-3x/month bursts at ~10M/5-10min: we can support them on Hosted with the soft-cap + expedited add-on model, but we recommend a short runbook/canary during initial rollout. If you need hard guarantees, Dedicated is the right path.
- Quota increase lead time: standard increases take 48-72 hours; expedited (approved via AM/CS) can be done within 24 hours and we can pre-approve a single auto-expedite trigger per month.

Attached is the updated pricing sheet and a one-page MAP that lays out milestones, acceptance criteria, and a proposed 30-day pilot (mutual-action-plan.pdf). I also linked the HubSpot deal and a sample DocuSign placeholder for your procurement team.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm that $850 baseline / $1,350 overage + expedited add-on flow is acceptable as a starting point (or tell us the number you want us to target).
2) If yes, I'll send an MPA and a procurement-ready quote (DocuSign) and we can schedule the pilot kickoff.
3) Optional: we can provision a short Dedicated trial if you want guaranteed bursts for the pilot — Rafael can scope capacity.

Rafael — can you confirm availability to scope a Dedicated trial if Acme asks?
